Angle: lists, rankings and compilations. 37 WebSearch calls; 3 WebFetch attempts (thekeyexecutives.com, en.wikipedia.org, entrepreneurship.duke.edu) were all EGRESS_BLOCKED, so all evidence is from search snippets.

What worked:
- The 'Top 100 Duke Alumni in Technology of 2021' list (thekeyexecutives / prweb) gave Levine, Gupta, Gelenbe, Kraynak, Kong, Stephens and Hwang.
- Wikipedia snippets for Duke VCs gave Ted Wang, Dan Levitan, David Beisel and Fred Ehrsam.
- Duke I&E 'Network in the News' and Fuqua/dukemag snippets gave Greg Baker (Towerview, Fuqua '91), Front Porch VP (MBA '12) and Jason Fernandez (MBA '08).
- site:signal.nfx.com searches for 'Duke University' and 'Fuqua' were the richest source of seed-stage GPs. Caution: some Signal ties are only 'Fuqua School of Business Network' membership, not a confirmed degree (Jeff Terrell, Zack Scott); these are flagged in duke_degree.

What did not work: Forbes Midas / Midas Seed / Midas Brink searches returned no named Duke alumni beyond Jeremy Levine's Forbes profile. A Forbes 2013 'Education of Venture Capitalists' article says Duke is represented on the Midas List but the snippet named no one. superscout.co/hub/duke gave only aggregate stats.

Excluded:
- Josh Stein (Threshold): Dartmouth/Stanford, not Duke.
- Grant Newlin (Newlin Ventures GP): Fuqua MBA 2018-2020, under the 8-year cutoff.
- John Burbank (Passport Capital): hedge fund.
